name: AI Knowledge Assistant
description: Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) based enterprise knowledge assistant that enables users to query unstructured documents using natural language. The system processes documents, generates embeddings, performs semantic similarity search, retrieves relevant context, and uses an LLM to generate grounded responses. Designed orchestration pipelines to coordinate retrieval, context preparation, prompt execution, and response generation. Applied prompt engineering and token optimization techniques to improve response quality and reduce unnecessary context sent to the LLM. Implemented multi-agent workflow automation for complex knowledge retrieval and reasoning tasks.
contributions: Designed and implemented RAG orchestration pipelines for enterprise document querying.
Implemented document retrieval and semantic search workflows using embeddings.
Applied prompt engineering techniques to improve LLM response accuracy and consistency.
Optimized retrieved context and token usage to control LLM costs and improve response efficiency.
Implemented multi-agent workflow automation for complex retrieval and reasoning tasks.
Designed the workflow to ground LLM responses in retrieved enterprise knowledge and reduce unsupported responses.

name: AI Bug Task Management
description: Built an AI-powered engineering task management system integrated with Redmine that analyzes incoming bug reports and automatically recommends the most suitable developer for each task. The system analyzes bug descriptions, identifies relevant project and technical context, and compares the issue against historical developer-task associations to determine the best assignment.
contributions: Integrated the system with Redmine to process incoming engineering bug reports.
Analyzed bug descriptions and extracted relevant technical and project context.
Built task classification workflows to identify the affected module, technology, and type of issue.
Analyzed historical project associations to determine developer expertise and previous ownership.
Implemented developer ranking logic to recommend the most suitable engineer for a new bug.
Automated task-assignment recommendations to reduce manual effort for engineering leads.

name: Lending Platform Modernization
description: Modernized a legacy PHP monolithic lending platform by decomposing business capabilities into independently deployable backend services. Worked on service boundaries, API design, backend implementation, data access, integration with existing legacy components, and incremental migration from the monolith to a modern microservices architecture. The modernization improved application scalability, maintainability, API performance, and production reliability.
contributions: Analyzed the legacy PHP monolith and identified business capabilities suitable for service decomposition.
Migrated critical backend functionality from the PHP monolith to Node.js-based services.
Designed RESTful APIs and service boundaries for independently deployable backend components.
Implemented backend services for lending workflows while maintaining compatibility with existing legacy systems.
Improved API performance through service-level optimization, efficient database access, and reduced processing overhead.
Worked on production reliability, debugging, monitoring, and performance optimization during the migration.
Reduced API latency by approximately 80%, from 1.5 seconds to 300 milliseconds.
Reduced production incidents by approximately 70%.
impact: Reduced API latency by 80% from 1.5 seconds to 300 milliseconds and decreased production incidents by 70%.
